test_suite.command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
test_suite.notes: 224 files passed, 3 skipped (41 tests skipped, pre-existing opt-in). Lint and typecheck had no errors. Coverage: 96.8% lines overall, table at 97.99% (session-record.ts 90.74% statements, 96.47% lines), storage at 94.23%. Thresholds met. No other vitest process was running.

end_to_end.command: npm run build && npx playwright test e2e/resume.spec.ts (Chromium + WebKit), plus a separate judge Playwright run of the spec section 10 manual scenario against the built preview
end_to_end.expected: Home shows 'Resume session' with 'Cash · N players · $4/$8 · K hands · paused' after New game. Resume opens the table at Hand #K+1 with the stored stacks and the dealer moved one seat. No start record is rewritten. The next hand is stored under the same sessionId, and Leave table shows the updated count.
end_to_end.actual: resume.spec.ts: 6/6 passed (3 tests x 2 browsers). Judge run, 9-player default game: played 3 hands, closed the tab in the middle of hand 4 and opened a new page in the same context. Home showed 'Cash · 9 players · $4/$8 · 3 hands · paused' with a background of rgb(26,29,34). Resume showed 'Cash · 9 players · $4/$8 · Hand #4' with seat stacks equal to the stored session's. The stored session was byte-identical after mount, so there was no start write. Hands held only [1,2,3] until hand 4 completed, then [1,2,3,4], all with one sessionId, and handsPlayed was 4. The dealer was on the stored button seat, not the hand-3 seat. Leave table showed '4 hands'. A newer New game session then became the Resume entry ('6 players · 0 hands'). Passed in Chromium and WebKit.

items.evidence: The named acceptance test passes and asserts the exact strings for 132/1/0 hands, 9p $10/$20 and sit-and-go 20/40, plus headerText unchanged. Holdout: '2 hands', '1000000000 hands', sit-and-go '1 hand', limitsText('$10/$20') and the 9-player headerText all match.

The acceptance test passes on fake-indexeddb and on findPausedSession. It covers empty, ended-only, the rule-1 A/B/C/D case (session C plus one RangeError), 132 hands, null or absent endedAt, and 'yesterday' or 5 giving 'Invalid session record: endedAt'. Holdout: '', true, {}, a date-only string and a non-round-trip ISO for endedAt are all rejected. An ended record newer than every paused one is ignored, in every input order.

The acceptance test passes. On relaunch over the same factory, handsPlayed is 10, handNumber 11, hand null and the ready state equals nextHand(t10). The hand 11 and 12 writes succeed under SESSION. Holdout: a 3-hand store relaunch restores hand 4 with nextHand stacks and button and no record 4, and pausedSession leaves the stored session unchanged.

The acceptance test passes. The 25-hand 9p Custom session restores to button 8, its next deal has button 8, and full toEqual matches nextHand(t25). The wrap-around case 7 → 1 holds. In the browser, e2e and the judge 9-player run both put the dealer on the stored next button.

The acceptance test passes. Records 1-10 exist, record 11 is null and count is 10. styleStats per seat equal the live hands 1-10. The restored userDecisions is [] at handNumber 11. In the judge browser run, no record 4 existed until hand 4 completed.

The acceptance test passes. A valid record plus a robot-kind record returns the valid one with a 'seats[1].kind' RangeError. The invalid record alone gives null. A newer DB version rejects with VersionError. Holdout: with a valid record, a newer MAX_SAFE_INTEGER record and a newer bad-endedAt record, the valid one is returned with two RangeErrors.

The acceptance test passes. All 7 edits throw field-named RangeErrors from restoreSession and parseSessionRecord and land in rejected. The line-up spies are never called, and they are shown to wrap the real functions afterwards.

The acceptance test passes for MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-1 and 1e9+1 on both fields, and 1e9 restores to handNumber 1e9+1. Holdout: -1, 1.5, Infinity, '3', nextBotId 0 and NaN are rejected with the field name. nextBotId 1e9 is accepted.

The unit test passes: tie-breaks by startedAt and then sessionId, reverse order gives the same result, 'x', null and [] are rejected, and parse keeps the same reference. Holdout: tie-breaks hold in both input orders. undefined, 42, a bad object and a throwing getter (a non-Error throw) are collected and never thrown.
The render test passes and asserts the exact Resume button markup, data-paused shown/none/loading and the button counts. The locked home.acceptance test still passes.

e2e passes in Chromium and WebKit. It covers a reload in hand 3, the '2 hands' subtitle, axe, Hand #3 with the stored seats, hands [1,2,3] under the same id, one session with handsPlayed 3, same-origin requests only, and '3 hands' after Leave. The judge holdout reproduces the same behaviour with 9 players and a closed tab.

e2e passes in both browsers: an empty profile and an ended-only profile give 'none' with no Resume. The seeded 9p $10/$20 Custom record shows '25 hands', resumes at Hand #26 with the stored names, styles and stacks, puts the dealer on seat 8, and passes axe.

e2e passes in both browsers for the robot kind and for MAX_SAFE_INTEGER handsPlayed: 'none', the error is logged, there is no pageerror, and New game deals hand 1 of a new session. A valid record plus a newer invalid one shows the valid record. Judge holdout: a garbage {sessionId,handsPlayed} value gives 'none', the log line and no page error in both browsers.

Lint, typecheck and npm test are all green. Coverage thresholds are met. git diff --stat main -- src/engine src/bots src/advice is empty. session-record.ts and table-view.ts import nothing from src/ui or src/storage.
npm run build && npm run e2e: 190 passed, 16 skipped (opt-in), 0 failed across Chromium and WebKit. gh run 45310957352 (CI, head 9d84cec) concluded success, and the Visual run also passed.

docs/storage/sessions.md documents endedAt (absent/null = not ended, written by E10), the MAX_SESSION_COUNT cap, the paused-session rule with invalid records skipped and logged, and the Resume flow (no start write, same id, numbering continues). The old 'no Resume screen yet' and 'no find the paused session query' lines are gone. The Backlog story doc is published by the later doit docs step and is not listed yet.

summary: All 16 SPEC items pass. The full Vitest suite passes (995 tests), and the full Playwright suite passes (190 tests in Chromium and WebKit), including e2e/resume.spec.ts. The judge holdout passes: 6 headless Vitest checks plus a 9-player close-tab/reopen/resume flow and a garbage-record check in both browsers. Integrity is clean: the only assertion-count warning comes from the merged TASK-1.56 change, not this story. No blocking findings. One minor note, not counted as a finding: a stored endedAt that is an own property with value undefined is rejected rather than treated as absent, which is consistent with the spec wording.
